permission-denied: This folder refused the write, so nothing changed. Allow Ontology Atlas to reach this folder in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, then try again.
target-missing: That folder or file is no longer there. It may have moved or been deleted, so open the folder again and retry.
already-exists: A file of that name is already there, so nothing was overwritten. Check the existing file or use another name, then try again.
app-required: This action creates a file directly in the folder, so only the desktop app can do it.
answer-history-unreadable: This answer's question or its link to earlier versions could not be read. Check that answer_thread in the info block at the top of the file starts with wiki/answers/, then try again.
answer-path-invalid: This answer does not live under wiki/answers/. Move the answer page into that folder, then try again.
answer-sources-unmeasured: One of the cited originals cannot be read right now, so the refresh did not start. Put the original files back, then try again.
answer-previous-changed: The previous answer or an original changed while this was being prepared, so it stopped. Nothing was saved; ask for the draft again.
answer-draft-mismatch: What you reviewed and what was about to be saved no longer match, so nothing was saved. Open the comparison again, then save.
answer-draft-invalid: The agent's draft cannot become a new version. Ask again for one body with its citations.
answer-revision-exists: A page already exists at that address, so nothing was overwritten. Open it in the Library to see what is there.
answer-turn-incomplete: The refresh did not finish. The previous answer is unchanged. Ask again when you are ready.
